scope: Render interior angle problems from the public given angles
notes: Triangle and quadrilateral angle questions no longer use a regular polygon surrogate
Diagram vertices are derived from public givens without reading the answer key
Only supplied angles are labelled; the remaining vertex is labelled with a question mark
Convex and reflex quadrilaterals are supported; positive edge lengths are solved before sampling a readable shape
New quadrilateral questions exclude a straight 180-degree vertex
Old saved questions adapt at rendering without changing their answer or stored diagram; historical straight-angle items show givens without a misleading figure
English diagram names use curated interior-angle terminology rather than Square
Interior arcs identify the intended angle; the reflex question mark is positioned inside its larger interior angle
Native counts span the initial and arc-refined builds; the final shared-help build also checked concept-help rendering and unchanged blank answers, and completed rounds were not replayed
Private UI, translation, QA, APKs, device and learner originals excluded
remaining: Home can feature an unfinished diagnostic from another country after returning to the previous profile; curriculum/session routing still needs correction
Entered-step support, varied supply, localization, typography, bear design and early-primary controls
